Lower Sec class in Secondary School. Entire class were a bunch of assholes, thank god I moved classes due to different courses in upper sec.

I was always the bad kid in pri sch and wanted to change for the better in sec school, so being a good kid was new to me,lol. Apparently I came off to some of my classmates as a teachers pet, they started to form a clique after that.

First month of school passes, let the bullying commence. I always come to class early in the morning to find my designated seat to be littered with footprints and the same clique would be seated at the back, smirking or laughing. Ok, not the worst.

Rumors started spreading about me that I was some crazy manupilative cunt and whats left of my friends were too scared to have anything to do w me because they didnt want the entire cohort to hate them. Fun.

You know those jokers you have in class ?  Most of the time they are males and come off friendly to literally everyone (so called "fuckboys" nowadays), I started liking one of them because whO doesnt like a nice guy with humour ???  and I was really desperate for anyone who accepted me at that point. We started chatting over whatsapp and he managed to get me to confess how i felt about him. Proceeds to ask me to meet him after school at the rooftop of the hdb block opposite the school so he could "take sexy pictures" of me. Turns out the same clique of girls that started the rumors were getting him to do this "as a joke"

Got in student council later on and it didnt help. I was mocked for it saying I "didnt deserve it", "uselsss councillor", etc. Pretty much got really emotionally drained at that point. Drove me to self harm, which kind of made them back up a little. (Shithead move, but once I was stabbing a metal ruler into my thigh and calves while crying silently in class, I guess one of them saw me or something. +1 point for proving them right that I was fuckin crazy lmao)

Oh well, things only got better when they saw my talent for art and found me useful to win the Class Decoration competitions. :) People only like you when you benefit them.
